meta.prompt: Show the weather in Lisbon as an inline card. Now: 22° and partly cloudy, high 24°, low 15°. The next five hours: 1 PM 23° sunny, 2 PM 24° sunny, 3 PM 24° partly cloudy, 4 PM 23° cloudy, 5 PM 21° rain. The next three days with a temperature range bar: Tue rain 14° to 20°, Wed partly cloudy 13° to 18°, Thu sunny 15° to 25°. Add a button "Alert me before it rains" that, once I press it, reads "Rain alert is on" and shows the alert as switched on.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Lisbon weather" "Right now" icon:"cloud" status:"Live" tone:"accent"
  WeatherNow "Lisbon" "Partly cloudy" temp:22 high:24 low:15 kind:"partly"
  WeatherHours hours:["1 PM","2 PM","3 PM","4 PM","5 PM"] temps:[23,24,24,23,21] kinds:["sun","sun","partly","cloud","rain"]
  SectionLabel "Next three days"
  WeatherDay label:"Tue" kind:"rain" low:14 high:20 min:13 max:25
  WeatherDay label:"Wed" kind:"partly" low:13 high:18 min:13 max:25
  WeatherDay label:"Thu" kind:"sun" low:15 high:25 min:13 max:25
  state alert=false
  if !alert
    ActionButton "Alert me before it rains" tone:"primary" -> alert=true
  if alert
    Callout "Rain alert is on" "We will warn you before the next rain." tone:"good" icon:"notifications_active"

delta: will warn you before the next r
